ety.text: Blend of инко́гнито (inkógnito, “incognito”) + гни́да (gnída, “nit; scumbag, rascal”). Perhaps the form was first used in the story “Inkognida” (1927) by Vasily Lebedev-Kumach. However, the form is used by him as the surname of the auditor with hyperbole and satire. The etymology was proposed by Margarita S. Maleeva in Leksicheskaya i sintaksicheskaya obʺektivaciya znaniya v slovoobrazovatel'nom kontekste (1983: 50).
